Head_and_Face: Face is heavily furnished with hair forming a distinctive fall over the eyes and a beard around the muzzle.
Facial features are obscured by heavy facial hair.
Ears are pendant-shaped, hanging close to the head, covered in long feathering.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is profusely double-layered with a soft woolly undercoat beneath a long, straight to slightly wavy outer coat.
Outer coat hangs in dense strands, typically in white, cream, gold, tricolor, or smoky gray.
Overall silhouette resembles a miniature Old English Sheepdog with a shaggy, unkempt profile.
Body length slightly exceeds height at withers.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is carried curled over the back in a tight spiral, heavily plumed with long hair creating a fan-like appearance.
Legs are heavily feathered with hair extending to the paws, giving a columnar appearance.
Paw pads are large and well-furred.

Head_and_Face: Head is small and wedge-shaped with a moderately long muzzle.
Ears are small, V-shaped, and erect, positioned high on the skull.
Eyes are small, dark, and almond-shaped, set beneath a silky topknot that falls forward.
Body_and_Plumage: Floor-length, pin-straight coat with a distinctive blue-and-tan coloration.
Rich steel blue covers the body from occiput to tail base, with tan markings on the head, chest, and legs.
Coat texture is exceptionally silky and lustrous, resembling human hair, with no undercoat.
Hair parts naturally along the spine, creating a clean center parting.
Body is low to the ground with proportions emphasizing length over height, creating a sleek, streamlined profile.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is docked or naturally carried high, plumed but not heavily feathered.
Legs are short and fine-boned.

Head_and_Face: Abundant facial furnishings: a full beard and mustache that obscure the lower face.
Prominent fall of hair over the eyes giving a shaggy, veiled appearance.
Head is rectangular in profile with a flat skull and moderate stop.
Ears are V-shaped, medium-sized, folding forward close to the cheeks.
Body_and_Plumage: Entire coat is a uniform pale wheaten color ranging from light beige to golden honey.
Coat texture is soft, silky, and gently wavy, falling in loose waves rather than tight curls.
Coat has a characteristic draping quality, falling naturally rather than standing away from the body.
Proportions are nearly square, with body length approximately equal to height at withers.
Body is compact with a level topline and deep chest.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is typically docked and carried erect, covered in the same wavy coat.
Legs are moderately feathered with hair extending to the pasterns.

Head_and_Face: Head is round and domed with a short, strong muzzle tapering to a black nose.
Ears are small, pointed, and carried erect, positioned wide apart on the skull.
Eyes are dark, widely set, and deep-set beneath prominent brow ridges.
Alert, fox-like expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is exclusively pure white, double-layered with a harsh, straight outer coat and a soft, dense undercoat.
Outer coat stands away from the body, creating a crisp profile.
Body is compact with a level topline and deep chest.
Overall silhouette is low-slung, sturdy, and alert.
Erect ears and tail create a distinctive triangular profile when viewed from the side.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is short, thick at the base, tapering to a point, carried erect and never curled over the back.
Legs are short, muscular, and heavily boned relative to body size, with dark pigmented skin and black nails.

Head_and_Face: Head is heavily furnished with a prominent topknot falling forward over the eyes and a full beard and mustache that obscure the muzzle.
Eyes are medium-sized, dark brown, and oval-shaped, partially hidden beneath the fall.
Ears are pendant-shaped, hanging close to the head, heavily feathered and blending into the neck coat.
Body_and_Plumage: Profuse, heavy, floor-length coat that is straight, hard in texture, and dense, parting naturally along the spine.
Coat colors include golden, sandy, honey, dark grizzle, slate, smoke, parti-color, white, and black.
Coat drapes heavily, creating a sweeping, flowing silhouette that obscures the body outline.
Body is longer than tall with a level topline.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is heavily plumed, carried curled over the back in a characteristic chrysanthemum shape where the hair radiates outward from the tail base.
Legs are heavily feathered with hair extending to the paws, creating a cylindrical appearance.

Head_and_Face: Head is clean-cut with a flat skull and moderate stop, featuring a long, powerful muzzle.
Eyes are medium-sized, brown to dark brown, almond-shaped.
Ears are small to medium, pendant-shaped, lying close to the head, set level with the skull.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is dense, fine to medium in texture, flat-lying against the body with moderate feathering on the chest, legs, and tail.
Coat colors are solid black or solid liver (dark brown), with a glossy, water-resistant sheen.
Body is long and low with a deep chest reaching to the elbows, a level topline, and well-sprung ribs.
Overall silhouette is elegant and racy, resembling a leaner, flatter-coated Golden Retriever.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is straight, carried level with the topline or slightly above, with moderate feathering creating a flag-like appearance.
Legs are long, muscular, and straight-boned with well-arched feet and thick pads.

Head_and_Face: Head is wedge-shaped with a flat skull and a long, deep muzzle.
Eyes are large, oval-shaped, and dark, set obliquely.
Ears are small, pendant-shaped, lying close to the head, covered in short curls.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat composed entirely of tight, crisp curls covering the entire body from head to tail.
No feathering on the legs, ears, or tail.
Coat colors are solid black or solid liver (dark brown).
Curls are small, uniform, and stand away from the body, creating a distinctive textured, almost woolly appearance.
Body is deep-chested with a short, strong loin and well-sprung ribs.
Overall silhouette is tall, square, and imposing with a distinctive curly-textured profile.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is moderate in length, thick at the base, tapering to a point, carried nearly level with the back, covered in short curls.
Legs are long, straight-boned, and muscular with well-arched, cat-like feet.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad with a straight profile, a well-defined stop, and a deep, wide muzzle.
Eyes are dark brown, widely set, with a friendly, intelligent expression.
Ears are medium-sized, pendant-shaped, hanging close to the cheeks.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is dense, water-repellent, with a flat or wavy outer coat and a soft undercoat.
Coat colors range from rich lustrous golden to light cream.
Feathering on the back of the forelegs, underside of the body, front of the neck, and back of the thighs.
Coat has a distinctive lustrous sheen in sunlight.
Body is slightly longer than tall with a level topline, deep chest, and well-sprung ribs.
Overall silhouette is symmetrical, balanced, and powerful with a characteristic golden-hued, feathered profile.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is thick and muscular at the base, carried with a merry action, covered in long feathering creating a flag-like appearance.
Legs are muscular with substantial bone, straight forelegs, and well-arched feet with thick pads.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad with a clean-cut skull, moderate stop, and a medium-length, powerful muzzle.
Eyes are medium-sized, brown or hazel, conveying an intelligent, kindly expression.
Ears are medium-sized, pendant-shaped, hanging close to the head, set slightly back.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short, dense, and straight with a hard, weather-resistant texture and a soft undercoat.
Coat colors are solid black, solid yellow (ranging from fox-red to light cream), or solid chocolate brown.
Coat lacks feathering on the legs, body, or tail, creating a clean, sleek profile.
Body is slightly longer than tall with a deep chest, level topline, and well-sprung ribs.
Overall silhouette is clean, athletic, and powerful with no feathering or long hair.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Defining feature is the otter tail: thick at the base, gradually tapering toward the tip, medium length, covered in short, dense hair creating a rounded, otter-like appearance.
Legs are straight-boned, muscular, with compact, well-arched feet and thick pads.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and round with a medium-length muzzle and a slight stop.
Eyes are yellowish or amber-colored, medium-sized, conveying an intelligent, intense expression.
Ears are small, pendant-shaped, hanging close to the head, set high on the skull.
Body_and_Plumage: Double coat: a short, harsh, wavy outer coat with a dense, fine, woolly undercoat.
Coat has a distinctive deadgrass, sedge, or brown coloration ranging from deep brown to light tan, often with a grizzled or brindled appearance.
Body is slightly longer than tall with a deep chest, level topline, and well-sprung ribs.
Overall silhouette is powerful and substantial with a distinctive wavy, deadgrass-colored profile.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is medium length, thick at the base, tapering to a point, carried straight or with a slight curve, covered in short wavy hair.
Legs are long, muscular, with well-arched feet featuring webbed toes.
